name: Durable Work Lifecycle Authority Layer
description: The coordination kernel depends on PGlite-backed lifecycle writes for authority. This mission establishes the durable work lifecycle schema and binding layer: work item durability, work attempt durability, lifecycle transitions, recovery receipts, dead-letter/quarantine tables, and the rule that every terminal Valkey ACK must be preceded by a committed PGlite lifecycle write.
purpose: The decisive missing piece in the coordination kernel is not Valkey mechanics but PGlite-backed lifecycle writes. This mission isolates the coordination-critical schema and binding so it does not get buried under broader intelligence-layer work (diagnostic packets, dharma ledger, vector search). Every work lifecycle state (enqueued, in-progress, completed, failed-terminal, failed-retryable, dead-lettered) must be represented as an ACID row before the corresponding Valkey stream entry is acknowledged.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkItemTable and WorkAttemptTable Drizzle schemas define all lifecycle states: enqueue_pending, in_progress, completed, failed_terminal, failed_retryable, dead_lettered
Every completeAndAck writes terminal durable state to PGlite before XACK
Every failRetryableAndAck writes retry-scheduled durable state to PGlite before requeue
Every deadLetterAndAck writes dead-letter durable record to PGlite before terminal XACK
DeadLetterTable and QuarantineTable schemas exist for divergence tracking
Recovery receipts are written for every rebuild action
